headline: Spanish government approves a 5.3% rise in the minimum wage and a 4.5% rise in public workers' salaries
summary: The Spanish government approved a 5.3% rise in the minimum wage for 2027, reaching 1,286 euros gross per month in fourteen payments. Public workers' salaries will rise 4.5%.
why: Minimum wage and public pay decisions affect labour costs, household incomes and inflation expectations in the Spanish economy.
